policy_notes_for_T6: A scanner with access_status other than accessible/accessible-log-only, or with no report at the expected path for the evaluated revision, is a failed check, never an empty pass.
A valid empty result requires the report file to exist and parse with the expected tool/run metadata (e.g. Trivy SARIF with runs[0].results == [] and tool version present).

T14 records actual exit statuses: npm/ESLint accept 0 or finding exit 1, cppcheck/Trivy accept 0 or configured finding exit 2. The findings policy still blocks new findings, scanner errors and incomplete coverage.
Revisions differ per scanner (see last_observed.revision); compare fingerprints, not line numbers.

fingerprint_schemes.codeql: codeql:<ruleId>:<path>:<SARIF partialFingerprints.primaryLocationLineHash>; fallback codeql-alert:<alert number> when the instance is not in the current analysis. Line-number independent.
fingerprint_schemes.line-tool: <tool>:<rule>:<repo-relative path>:sha256('<rule>|<path>|<message with \d+ -> N>|<occurrence index within that triple, ordered by line>')[:16]. Line numbers are excluded so header/SPDX shifts do not churn identity; runner prefix /__w/lightNVR/lightNVR/ is stripped.
fingerprint_schemes.bucket: <tool>-bucket:<rule>:<path> with an integer count; policy compares counts (increase = new finding, decrease = progress requiring baseline edit).
fingerprint_schemes.advisory: repo-advisory:sha256(GHSA id)[:16] so private advisory IDs are not disclosed
